name: Offline Identity Cache
description: Identity information (profiles, public keys, role assignments, group memberships) is cached locally for offline operation. Cache has configurable TTL and refreshes on reconnect.
purpose: Enable core identity operations during network partitions without sacrificing correctness on reconnect.
acceptanceCriteria: Offline cache schema: local store for profile, public keys, role assignments, group memberships
Cache TTL per entity type with configurable defaults
Stale-while-revalidate: serve cached entries while fetching fresh data in background
Cache invalidation on reconnect via version vector or change log
Conflict resolution: server data wins on reconnect, local writes queued for re-application
Cache preloading on first sync after authentication
Cache metrics: hit rate, staleness age, eviction count
